Exercise: Groin and Back Stretch

Category:
stretching

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
static

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- flexion
- extension_of_the_hip_joint
- spinal_flexion

Primary Muscles:

- adductors

Secondary Muscles:
None

Equipment:
None

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
low

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- increase_flexibility_in_the_hips_and_spine
- improve_spinal_mobility

Contraindications:

- Recent lower back surgery
- Severe hip or spinal injuries

Exercise Variations:
None

Substitution Options:

- name: Seated Spinal Twist, force: static, level: intermediate

Instructions:

- Sit on the floor with your knees bent and feet together.
- Interlock your fingers behind your head. This will be your starting position.
- Curl downwards, bringing your elbows to the inside of your thighs. After a brief pause, return to the starting position with your head up and your back straight. Repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
